exposure: Mid-trimester sonographic cervical length measurement (using transvaginal ultrasonography)
outcome: Preterm birth (delivery before 37 weeks of gestational age)
cohort: Pregnant mothers attending a tertiary care teaching hospital for follow-up from 18-24 weeks gestation until delivery.
finding: Mid-trimester transvaginal ultrasonography to determine cervical length has the potential to help forecast the probability of preterm labor.
gest_age: Gestational age at cervical length measurement ranged from 18 to 22 weeks (mean 20.56 weeks); outcomes included preterm birth (less than 37 weeks) and term birth (at and more than 37 weeks).
